info.title: Netzertech University Multi-Tenant API Suite
info.description:
## Netzertech University Multi-Tenant Enterprise Backend API

Welcome to the **Netzertech University** interactive API documentation. This comprehensive suite powers multi-institutional academic workflows, digital admissions, learning management (LMS), online CBT assessments, financial billing & split gateway payments, campus facilities, digital ID verification, postgraduate school governance, AI academic advising, career planning, and peer study groups.

### Multi-Tenancy
All requests require the university tenant identification header:
```http
X-University-Code: NVU
```
*(Example codes: `NVU` for Novica University, `APEX` for Apex Institute of Technology)*

### Authentication
Protected endpoints require a Laravel Sanctum Bearer Token:
```http
Authorization: Bearer <your_access_token>
```
